docs.text: The latest episode of my favorite show is on (watching the sun set over Lake Erie). #TimeLineCleanse

Our first episode of 2025 is almost here 🌊 Take a look at efforts to manage Canada geese. Go underwater to see how divers are saving freshwater mussels. And learn about the Indigenous history of the #GreatLakes fur trade. Premieres on Detroit PBS this Monday at 7:30 PM ET: youtu.be/b7gc71viG7I
Gilligan's Island set in Lake Superior would have been a hell of a show

I would enjoy a six-season series of a Cthulu-esque 1930's detective show where you stumble upon a great conspiracy in which R'ley is actually located underneath Lake Superior, only to realize we all actually want them to rise up.

Our latest episode is almost here 🌊 Learn about how communities are tackling the threat of invasive phragmites, lakebed mapping and the future of the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative. Premieres on Detroit PBS this Monday at 7:30 PM ET: youtu.be/4lfQXeWltNE

TONIGHT on Detroit PBS! Fighting phragmites, lakebed mapping and the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative. Read about "Battling Invaders and Exploring Hidden Habitats" and catch the episode premiere at 7:30 PM ET: www.greatlakesnow.org/battling-inv...

New Episode Alert! Last week, the guys took vacations, Brad and Paddy thru-paddled the mighty Au Sable River and Travy J did a little rock hounding on the shores of Lake Michigan! #puremichigan #lakemichigan #ausableriver #paddle #kayak #rockhound #nature #podcast open.spotify.com/episode/1QbE...

TONIGHT on Detroit PBS! Preparing for a Great Lakes oil spill and a look at “ghost streams” — the invisible buried rivers that flow beneath our feet. Read about "Oil Spills and Buried Rivers" and catch the episode premiere at 7:30 PM: greatlakesnow.org/oil-spills-and-buried-rivers/

TONIGHT on Detroit PBS! A freighter takes on water in Lake Superior and a lawsuit over farming on wetlands. Read about "Rescuing Freighters and Busting Swamps" and catch the episode premiere at 7:30 PM ET: www.greatlakesnow.org/rescuing-fre...
It's here! What happens if there’s an oil spill in the Great Lakes? And what is the story behind the hidden rivers fueling urban floods? Find out in our latest episode: youtu.be/JmOD1xOc7m4

I'm already thinking of the finale of S1 and I've only just got through episode two. The beauty of #Andor is how authentic it is. The plight of Ferrix is North East UK industrial towns, mining communities or the great lakes industrial towns or Appalachian and Midwest Coal Towns.

On the next episode of Great Lakes Now, find out what it would take to clean up an oil spill in the Great Lakes. Plus, discover how buried waterways contribute to flooding. Premieres on Detroit PBS Monday, November 25 at 7:30 PM ET 🌊 Watch the promo: youtu.be/RIBpnoR7Ro4

Our latest episode is almost here! 📺 Learn about how centuries-old practices could fight wildfires in the Great Lakes region, why rainfall is getting more intense and the story of snow mobiles. Premieres on Detroit PBS Monday, April 28 at 7:30 PM ET: youtu.be/B_Xmk7NUEOQ

Today in 1995 the ER episode "Men Plan, God Laughs" aired on NBC. In the episode Wendy (Vanessa Marquez) assists Ross (George Clooney) in treating a girl who is temporarily deaf after visiting her mother at a Lake Michigan naval base. #ER #VanessaMarquez
